content: For small-team Next.js+Postgres greenfield apps: Vercel is the best fit for the Next.js frontend/API (zero-config, Fluid Compute active-CPU pricing cuts idle-heavy function bills), pairs natively with Neon Postgres via Marketplace integration. Railway is easiest all-in-one PaaS (drag-drop, managed Postgres bundled) but less optimized for Next.js specifically. Fly.io gives full VM control, best for teams needing persistent global compute, more ops overhead.
